dp1.name: Dialga
dp1.effect: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

dp1.name: Dusknoir
dp1.effect: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

dp1.name: Electivire
dp1.effect: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

dp1.name: Empoleon
dp1.effect: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

dp1.name: Infernape
dp1.effect: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

dp1.name: Lucario
dp1.effect: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

dp1.name: Luxray
dp1.effect: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

dp1.name: Magnezone
dp1.effect: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

dp1.name: Manaphy
dp1.effect: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

dp1.name: Mismagius
dp1.effect: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.

dp1.name: Palkia
dp1.effect: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

dp1.name: Rhyperior
dp1.effect: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

dp1.name: Roserade
dp1.effect: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

dp1.name: Shiftry
dp1.effect: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

dp1.name: Skuntank
dp1.effect: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

dp1.name: Staraptor
dp1.effect: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

dp1.name: Torterra
dp1.effect: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

dp1.name: Azumarill
dp1.effect: It lives in rivers and lakes. In water, its coloring and patterns trick the vision of foes.

dp1.name: Beautifly
dp1.effect: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

dp1.name: Bibarel
dp1.effect: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

dp1.name: Carnivine
dp1.effect: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

dp1.name: Clefable
dp1.effect: Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by the full moon to play at deserted lakes.

dp1.name: Drapion
dp1.effect: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

dp1.name: Drifblim
dp1.effect: It's drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

dp1.name: Dustox
dp1.effect: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

dp1.name: Floatzel
dp1.effect: It floats using its well-developed floatation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

dp1.name: Gengar
dp1.effect: It hides in shadows. It is said that if Gengar is hiding, it cools that area by nearly 10 degrees F.

dp1.name: Heracross
dp1.effect: It gathers in forests to search for tree sap, its favorite food. It's strong enough to hurl foes.

dp1.name: Hippowdon
dp1.effect: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

dp1.name: Lopunny
dp1.effect: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

dp1.name: Machamp
dp1.effect: It punches with its four arms at blinding speed. It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.

dp1.name: Medicham
dp1.effect: Through yoga training, it has honed its sixth sense. Its movements are elegant.

dp1.name: Munchlax
dp1.effect: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.

dp1.name: Noctowl
dp1.effect: Its eyes are special. They can pick out objects as long as there is the tiniest amount of light.

dp1.name: Pachirisu
dp1.effect: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

dp1.name: Purugly
dp1.effect: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own.

dp1.name: Snorlax
dp1.effect: Its stomach can digest any kind of food, even if it happens to be moldy or rotten.

dp1.name: Steelix
dp1.effect: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

dp1.name: Vespiquen
dp1.effect: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.

dp1.name: Weavile
dp1.effect: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

dp1.name: Wobbuffet
dp1.effect: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

dp1.name: Wynaut
dp1.effect: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.

dp1.name: Budew
dp1.effect: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

dp1.name: Cascoon
dp1.effect: It is hot inside its cocoon. All the cells in its body create the energy for it to evolve.

dp1.name: Cherrim
dp1.effect: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

dp1.name: Drifloon
dp1.effect: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

dp1.name: Dusclops
dp1.effect: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.

dp1.name: Elekid
dp1.effect: It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can't store the energy it makes.

dp1.name: Grotle
dp1.effect: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

dp1.name: Haunter
dp1.effect: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.

dp1.name: Hippopotas
dp1.effect: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

dp1.name: Luxio
dp1.effect: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

dp1.name: Machoke
dp1.effect: MACHOKE's boundless power is very dangerous, so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.

dp1.name: Magneton
dp1.effect: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.

dp1.name: Mantyke
dp1.effect: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

dp1.name: Monferno
dp1.effect: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.

dp1.name: Nuzleaf
dp1.effect: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

dp1.name: Prinplup
dp1.effect: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

dp1.name: Rapidash
dp1.effect: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.

dp1.name: Rhydon
dp1.effect: Its brain developed after it stood up on its hind legs. Its drill horn bores tunnels through solid rock.

dp1.name: Riolu
dp1.effect: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

dp1.name: Seaking
dp1.effect: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. It defends its eggs with its life.

dp1.name: Silcoon
dp1.effect: It anchors itself by wrapping twigs with the silk from its body. It motionlessly awaits evolution.

dp1.name: Staravia
dp1.effect: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

dp1.name: Unown [A]
dp1.effect: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

dp1.name: Unown [B]
dp1.effect: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

dp1.name: Unown [C]
dp1.effect: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

dp1.name: Unown [D]
dp1.effect: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

dp1.name: Azurill
dp1.effect: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.

dp1.name: Bidoof
dp1.effect: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

dp1.name: Bonsly
dp1.effect: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body's fluid levels by eliminating excess.

dp1.name: Buizel
dp1.effect: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

dp1.name: Buneary
dp1.effect: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

dp1.name: Chatot
dp1.effect: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

dp1.name: Cherubi
dp1.effect: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

dp1.name: Chimchar
dp1.effect: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

dp1.name: Clefairy
dp1.effect: Thought to live with others on quiet mountains, it is popular for its adorable nature.

dp1.name: Cleffa
dp1.effect: Its silhouette is like a star. It is believed to arrive riding on shooting stars.

dp1.name: Combee
dp1.effect: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.

dp1.name: Duskull
dp1.effect: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

dp1.name: Electabuzz
dp1.effect: Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.

dp1.name: Gastly
dp1.effect: This Pokémon's body is 95% made up of gases, which are blown away by strong gusts of wind.

dp1.name: Glameow
dp1.effect: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness if very popular among some.

dp1.name: Goldeen
dp1.effect: It swims elegantly by flittering its tail as if it were a dress. It has the look of a queen.

dp1.name: Hoothoot
dp1.effect: It always stands on one foot. Even when attacked, it does not brace itself using both feet.

dp1.name: Machop
dp1.effect: It hefts a GRAVELER repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

dp1.name: Magnemite
dp1.effect: The units at its sides generate electromagnetic waves that keep it airborne. It feeds on electricity.

dp1.name: Marill
dp1.effect: Using its tail as a float, it dives underwater. It likes eating plants that grow on river bottoms.

dp1.name: Meditite
dp1.effect: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

dp1.name: Mime Jr.
dp1.effect: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

dp1.name: Misdreavus
dp1.effect: It loves to sneak up on people late at night, then startle them with its shrieklike cry.

dp1.name: Onix
dp1.effect: When it travels underground, it causes rumbling and tremors. It can move at 50 mph.

dp1.name: Piplup
dp1.effect: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

dp1.name: Ponyta
dp1.effect: About an hour after birth, its fiery mane and tail grow out, giving it an impressive appearance.

dp1.name: Rhyhorn
dp1.effect: Its body is clad in a thick hide, and its tackles topple buildings. Unfortunately, it is not smart.

dp1.name: Roselia
dp1.effect: ROSELIA raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.

dp1.name: Seedot
dp1.effect: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

dp1.name: Shinx
dp1.effect: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

dp1.name: Skorupi
dp1.effect: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

dp1.name: Sneasel
dp1.effect: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.

dp1.name: Starly
dp1.effect: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

dp1.name: Stunky
dp1.effect: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

dp1.name: Turtwig
dp1.effect: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

dp1.name: Wurmple
dp1.effect: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a STARLY, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.

dp1.name: Double Full Heal
dp1.effect: Remove all Special Conditions from each of your Active Pokémon.

dp1.name: Energy Restore
dp1.effect: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, put a basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand. If you don't have that many basic Energy cards in your discard pile, put all of them into your hand.

dp1.name: Energy Switch
dp1.effect: Move a basic Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

dp1.name: Night Pokémon Center
dp1.effect: Choose 1 of your Pokémon. Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, remove all damage counters from that Pokémon. If both are tails, discard all Energy cards attached to that Pokémon.

dp1.name: PlusPower
dp1.effect: Attach PlusPower to 1 of your Pokémon. Discard this card at the end of your turn. If the Pokémon PlusPower is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

dp1.name: Poké Ball
dp1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

dp1.name: Pokédex HANDY910is
dp1.effect: Look at the top 2 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and put it into your hand. Put the other card on the bottom of your deck.

dp1.name: Professor Rowan
dp1.effect: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card. Choose 1 card in your hand and shuffle the rest of your cards into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. (If this is the only card in your hand, you can't play this card.)

dp1.name: Rival
dp1.effect: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card. Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Your opponent chooses 3 of those cards. Put those cards into your hand and put other 2 cards on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

dp1.name: Speed Stadium
dp1.effect: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card. Once during each player's turn, the player may flip a coin until he or she gets tails. For each heads, that player draws a card.

dp1.name: Super Scoop Up
dp1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, return 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

dp1.name: Warp Point
dp1.effect: Your opponent switches 1 of his or her Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. You switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon, if any.

dp1.name: Energy Search
dp1.effect: Search your deck for a basic Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

dp1.name: Potion
dp1.effect: Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon (remove 1 damage counter if that Pokémon has only 1).

dp1.name: Switch
dp1.effect: Switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

dp1.name: Empoleon LV.X
dp1.effect: Put this card onto your Active Empoleon. Empoleon LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

dp1.name: Infernape LV.X
dp1.effect: Put this card onto your Active Infernape. Infernape LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

dp1.name: Torterra LV.X
dp1.effect: Put this card onto your Active Torterra. Torterra LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

dp2.name: Aggron
dp2.effect: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

dp2.name: Alakazam
dp2.effect: Its superb memory lets it recall everything it has experienced from birth. Its IQ exceeds 5,000.

dp2.name: Ambipom
dp2.effect: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

dp2.name: Azelf
dp2.effect: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

dp2.name: Blissey
dp2.effect: This kindhearted Pokémon nurses sick Pokémon to health. It senses feelings of sadness.

dp2.name: Bronzong
dp2.effect: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

dp2.name: Celebi
dp2.effect: It has the power to travel across time, but is is said to appear only in peaceful times.

dp2.name: Feraligatr
dp2.effect: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

dp2.name: Garchomp
dp2.effect: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

dp2.name: Honchkrow
dp2.effect: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.

dp2.name: Lumineon
dp2.effect: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

dp2.name: Magmortar
dp2.effect: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

dp2.name: Meganium
dp2.effect: Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead plants and flowers.

dp2.name: Mesprit
dp2.effect: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

dp2.name: Raichu
dp2.effect: It turns aggressive if it has too much electricity in its body. It discharges power through its tail.

dp2.name: Typhlosion
dp2.effect: It attacks using blasts of fire. It creates heat shimmers with intense fire to hide itself.

dp2.name: Tyranitar
dp2.effect: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

dp2.name: Uxie
dp2.effect: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

dp2.name: Abomasnow
dp2.effect: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

dp2.name: Ariados
dp2.effect: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.

dp2.name: Bastiodon
dp2.effect: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

dp2.name: Chimecho
dp2.effect: To knock foes flying, it makes the air shudder with its cries. It converses using seven cries.

dp2.name: Crobat
dp2.effect: Having four wings enables it to fly faster and more quietly. It turns active when the night comes.

dp2.name: Exeggutor
dp2.effect: It is called "The Walking Jungle." If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an EXEGGCUTE.

dp2.name: Glalie
dp2.effect: To protect itself, it clads its body in an armor of ice, made by freezing moisture in the air.

dp2.name: Gyarados
dp2.effect: Once it appears, its rage never settles until it has razed the fields and mountains around it.

dp2.name: Kricketune
dp2.effect: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

dp2.name: Manectric
dp2.effect: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

dp2.name: Mantine
dp2.effect: When the waves are calm, one may encounter a swarm of Mantine swimming as if they are in flight.

dp2.name: Mr. Mime
dp2.effect: It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.

dp2.name: Nidoqueen
dp2.effect: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.

dp2.name: Ninetales
dp2.effect: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

dp2.name: Rampardos
dp2.effect: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

dp2.name: Slaking
dp2.effect: The world's laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

dp2.name: Sudowoodo
dp2.effect: Despite appearing to be a tree, its body is closer to rocks and stones. It is very weak to water.

dp2.name: Toxicroak
dp2.effect: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

dp2.name: Unown [I]
dp2.effect: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

dp2.name: Ursaring
dp2.effect: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

dp2.name: Walrein
dp2.effect: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

dp2.name: Whiscash
dp2.effect: It is very territorial. It repels foes by setting of tremors that extend over a three-mile radius.

dp2.name: Bayleef
dp2.effect: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

dp2.name: Chingling
dp2.effect: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

dp2.name: Cranidos
dp2.effect: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

dp2.name: Croconaw
dp2.effect: Once it bites down, it won't let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

dp2.name: Dewgong
dp2.effect: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.

dp2.name: Dodrio
dp2.effect: When DODUO evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.

dp2.name: Dunsparce
dp2.effect: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

dp2.name: Gabite
dp2.effect: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scale will heal even incurable illnesses.

dp2.name: Girafarig
dp2.effect: Its tail also has a small brain. It bites to repel any foe trying to sneak up on it from behind.

dp2.name: Golbat
dp2.effect: It loves the blood of humans and Pokémon. It flies around at night in search of neck veins.

dp2.name: Graveler
dp2.effect: GRAVELER make their homes on sheer cliff faces by gouging out numerous horizontal holes.

dp2.name: Happiny
dp2.effect: It loves round white things. It carries and egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

dp2.name: Lairon
dp2.effect: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.

dp2.name: Magmar
dp2.effect: Born in the spout of a volcano, its body is covered by flames that shimmer like the sun.

dp2.name: Masquerain
dp2.effect: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

dp2.name: Nidorina
dp2.effect: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than NIDORINO's.

dp2.name: Octillery
dp2.effect: It lives in the gaps of boulders and in holes on the seafloor. Its suction cups grip prey tightly.

dp2.name: Parasect
dp2.effect: A mushroom grown larger than the host's body controls PARASECT. It scatters poisonous spores.

dp2.name: Pupitar
dp2.effect: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

dp2.name: Quilava
dp2.effect: It intimidates foes with the heat of its flames. The fire burn more strongly when it readies to fight.

dp2.name: Sandslash
dp2.effect: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.

dp2.name: Sealeo
dp2.effect: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

dp2.name: Shieldon
dp2.effect: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.

dp2.name: Tropius
dp2.effect: Because it continually ate only its favorite fruit, the fruit started growing around its neck.

dp2.name: Unown [E]
dp2.effect: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

dp2.name: Unown [M]
dp2.effect: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

dp2.name: Unown [T]
dp2.effect: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

dp2.name: Vigoroth
dp2.effect: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still even for a moment.

dp2.name: Abra
dp2.effect: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it teleports itself while remaining seated.

dp2.name: Aipom
dp2.effect: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.

dp2.name: Aron
dp2.effect: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

dp2.name: Barboach
dp2.effect: It coats its entire body with a slimy fluid so it can squirm and slip away if grabbed.

dp2.name: Bidoof
dp2.effect: Wacan Berry: Any damage done to Bidoof by attacks from Lightning Pokémon is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

dp2.name: Bronzor
dp2.effect: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

dp2.name: Buizel
dp2.effect: Chesto Berry: If Buizel is Asleep, remove the Special Condition Asleep from Buizel at the end of each player's turn.

dp2.name: Chansey
dp2.effect: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.

dp2.name: Chikorita
dp2.effect: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

dp2.name: Croagunk
dp2.effect: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

dp2.name: Cyndaquil
dp2.effect: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

dp2.name: Doduo
dp2.effect: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

dp2.name: Electrike
dp2.effect: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

dp2.name: Exeggcute
dp2.effect: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

dp2.name: Finneon
